expectedBehavior: Empty narrative fields render an explicit placeholder such as 'None recorded.', matching how Issue detail already handles empty observedBehavior, expectedBehavior, and reproductionSteps sections.
notes: Measured 2026-09-05: narrative fields are empty across much of canonical state - Task rationale empty in 147/191, Epic goal and rationale in 10/25 each, Sprint goal in 6/45. The data gap is real; this Issue covers only the rendering of it.
Issue detail already renders 'None recorded.' for empty sections, so the fix is to make Sprint, Epic, and Task detail consistent with that existing convention.
No Sprint assigned: no Sprint is currently Active. The workspace config names SP-023 and EP-018 as active, but both are Closed.
Whether these narrative fields should become required is a separate question, recorded against EP-026.
observedBehavior: Sprint and Epic detail views print a field header with no value when the underlying narrative field is empty. SP-039 renders '**Goal:** ' with nothing after it and EP-025 renders '**Goal:**' followed by whitespace, which reads as a missing feature rather than missing content. Task detail omits the rationale line entirely when empty.
reproductionSteps: Open AgileCockpit. From the Dashboard status tiles select Sprints > Planning > SP-039, or Epics > Active > EP-025, or Tasks > Active > T-0190. Observe the Goal or rationale section in the detail pane.

workItem.title: Empty narrative fields render as blank sections in Sprint and Epic detail views
